recipes.title: White Wine Garlic Pan Sauce
recipes.ingredients:
1 tbsp butter plus 3 tbsp more for later
1 large shallot, minced
salt to taste
4 cloves garlic, minced
1 cup dry white wine (sauvignon blanc)
1 cup chicken stock
minced parsley or chives for garnish

recipes.title: Upside Down Sicilian — Pizza Dough
recipes.ingredients:

385g water
12g salt
8g sugar
2.8g instant yeast
17g vegetable shortening
Portion dough balls to 879g

recipes.title: Chicken Bacon Ranch Sliders
recipes.ingredients:
Chicken
bacon
King's Hawaiian rolls
cheese
green onion
ranch dressing
recipes.steps:
Season and grill chicken; cook bacon.
Assemble sliders on King's Hawaiian rolls with cheese, chicken, green onion, and bacon; bake 15 minutes.
Serve with ranch.
